datasets.name: Tiny Shakespeare · character benchmark
datasets.description: About 1.1 MB (40,000 lines) of Shakespeare plays, the classic char-rnn/nanoGPT character-level sanity benchmark. Useful for checking that loss falls and samples become Shakespeare-like; not a research corpus. Not committed: fetch it with `uv run python -m training_data.fetching.fetch_tinyshakespeare`.
datasets.license_notes: Shakespeare's works are public domain; the compilation is distributed in the MIT-licensed char-rnn repository. Kept out of Git and downloaded locally for this learning benchmark only.

datasets.name: Complete Shakespeare · Project Gutenberg #100
datasets.description: About 5.4 MB of Shakespeare's complete works (plays, sonnets and poems; 100 distinct characters including curly quotes, dashes and a few accented letters), roughly five times Tiny Shakespeare. Contents, stage directions and Gutenberg line numbering in the poems are retained; only the Project Gutenberg header and license footer are removed. A larger learning corpus, not a research corpus. Not committed: fetch it with `uv run python -m training_data.fetching.fetch_shakespeare_complete`.
datasets.source: https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/100/pg100.txt, revision updated 2025-08-24 (download SHA-256 3cf4b3d44ee14cff4e14e78e2ad3318eff76f3f7f2afc3cee6bb925879110a37; stripped text SHA-256 bfb5a5764506115cbae33bfdf66014697ef69d06339f001db209d3f2a56c83fc)
datasets.license_notes: Shakespeare's works are public domain in the United States. The Project Gutenberg header and license footer are stripped, so the saved file is the public-domain text without Project Gutenberg trademarks. Kept out of Git and downloaded locally for learning experiments only.
